name: Barbell Landmine Press
steps: Stand facing a barbell anchored at its far end, set your feet shoulder-width apart, and cup the free end in both hands at upper-chest height.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly with your elbows tucked down close to your ribs.
Press the bar smoothly upward and forward along its natural arc until your arms extend fully.
Lower the end of the bar slowly back to your upper chest under full control.
tips: Keep your core braced and ribs down so you do not lean backward as the bar rises.
Reach slightly forward with your shoulder blades at the top without shrugging toward your ears.
